svg.title: Aven system architecture
svg.desc: Swaps enter the Uniswap v4 PoolManager, which calls AvenHook; AvenHook uses the AvenFairValue library, which reads HyperCore's oracle and mark price precompiles in the same block and returns an override fee. Off-chain services only trade, quote and verify.
svg.text: One path sets every fee: PoolManager → AvenHook → AvenFairValue → HyperCore. Everything off-chain is a client that can trade, quote and verify, never set a fee.
